responsibility: Declares the visitor-based Rust HIR dumping utility. The Dump class derives from HIRFullVisitor, stores output stream and indentation state, exposes a go method for rendering an HIR::Crate, and lists visit overrides for the full set of HIR node categories so the dumper can print a structured textual representation of expressions, items, patterns, statements, paths, and types. This header defines the debugging/inspection interface rather than HIR node semantics themselves.
same_name_distinction: Declares the Dump visitor class, its output/indentation state, and the full set of HIR visit hooks for textual dumping; rust-hir-dump.cc provides the actual printing implementations and stubs.
